GLS.feature.pf2e-variant-rules.title: PF2e Variant Rules
GLS.feature.pf2e-variant-rules.hint: Optional rules from Adventures+. Enable this, then switch on the individual rules your table uses.
GLS.feature.vr-careful-consumption.title: Careful Consumption
GLS.feature.vr-careful-consumption.hint: Spend an extra action to take the maximum from a consumable instead of rolling.
GLS.feature.vr-chip-damage.title: Chip Damage
GLS.feature.vr-chip-damage.hint: A missed Strike or a critically successful save still deals a little guaranteed damage.
GLS.feature.vr-dents.title: Dents
GLS.feature.vr-dents.hint: Item durability as a dent count rather than a broken threshold.
GLS.feature.vr-lasting-wounds.title: Lasting Wounds
GLS.feature.vr-lasting-wounds.hint: Wounded survives a night's rest, hampers Medicine checks, and cuts healing received.
GLVR.settings.careful.healingOnly.name: Healing consumables only
GLVR.settings.careful.healingOnly.hint: Offer Careful Consumption only on items that restore Hit Points. The rule permits any variable effect at the GM's discretion; this restricts it to the common case.
GLVR.settings.careful.postRoll.name: Allow maximizing after the roll
GLVR.settings.careful.postRoll.hint: Adds a button to an already-rolled consumable card that raises the result to its maximum. This is more permissive than the rule: a player only presses it after seeing a bad roll, which removes the decision the activity exists to create. Off by default.
GLVR.settings.chip.autoApply.name: Apply chip damage automatically
GLVR.settings.chip.autoApply.hint: Skip the button and apply chip damage as soon as a qualifying outcome is posted. Off by default: PF2e exposes no hook on damage application, so the button is the safer path.
GLVR.settings.chip.useFlattenedLevel.hin: In a Proficiency Without Level world, reduce chip damage by the same amount PF2e Flatten subtracts from rolls. Off by default, because chip damage is a flat figure rather than a check.
GLVR.settings.dent.autoApply.name: Apply dents automatically
GLVR.settings.dent.autoApply.hint: Add dents without asking when an item takes damage.
GLVR.settings.dent.repairButton.name: Offer dent removal on Repair checks
GLVR.settings.dent.repairButton.hint: Add a button to a Repair check result that removes 1 dent on a success and 2 on a critical success.
GLVR.settings.wound.blockRest.name: Wounded survives a night's rest
GLVR.settings.wound.blockRest.hint: Rest no longer clears the wounded condition. PF2e's own rest summary will still report it as removed; a follow-up note says otherwise.
GLVR.settings.wound.medicinePenalty.name: Medicine penalty
GLVR.settings.wound.medicinePenalty.hint: Medicine checks targeting a wounded creature take a circumstance penalty equal to its wounded value. Treat Wounds records no target, so the patient is read from your current target or selected token.
GLVR.settings.wound.healingPenalty.name: Healing penalty
GLVR.settings.wound.healingPenalty.hint: Hit Points restored to a wounded creature are reduced by twice its wounded value. Applies to healing from chat cards; dragging a token's HP bar bypasses every modifier in PF2e and is unaffected.
GLVR.chip.title: Chip Damage
GLVR.chip.body: {target} takes chip damage from an effect that dealt none.
GLVR.chip.negated: {target} resists {type}, and a creature whose resistance applies ignores chip damage entirely.
GLVR.careful.title: Careful Consumption
GLVR.careful.hint: Take the maximum from this item instead of rolling.
GLVR.careful.flavorChirurgeon: {name}, consumed carefully: maximum plus {bonus} rolled, for {total}.
GLVR.dents.title: Dents
GLVR.dents.repairBody: This result removes {count} dent(s). Choose the item repaired.
GLVR.wounds.restBody: The night's rest did not clear these wounds. PF2e's rest summary above reports them as removed; they were restored afterwards.
GLVR.error.noToken: {name} has no token on this scene, so the damage was not applied.
